primary_insight: Clock-Incommensurability Class: after subtracting undersampling, TAC, and NCR, the remaining unknown is that observation cadence cannot resolve process cadence, so named scientific objects are freeze-frames. Highest remaining allowed surface is JWST little red dots named as a class versus a transient black-hole-star / hidden-host phase (Naidu 12 Aug 2026; interpretation unproved). Highest unspoken living-system surface is insect dark taxa: ~80% unnamed, ~450 years at current description rates, and unnamed species are more extinction-prone — the catalog is slower than the loss.
capability_gap_identified: No existing tool tracks, against a local archive of already-claimed structural classes, whether a scientific unknown is a missing place (undersampling), a missing converter (TAC), an insufficient named cause (NCR), or a clock incommensurability (cadence / phase-object collapse / loss-outruns-catalog / two-clock metrology) — and whether the observation cadence can in principle resolve the process, so a new session cannot reclaim yesterday's gap.
